newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 4-, 13-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 4-, 13-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via four- and 13-day fixed system repurchase agreements Thursday, the New York Fed said.
The dual tranche was not a surprise, given the large add need over the next couple of weeks, analysts said.
The operation came an hour earlier than its usual 1130 EST/1630 GMT intervention period, even though federal funds traded only slightly above target at 5-5/16 percent.
In January, the Fed will move its intervention time to 1030 EST/1530 GMT.
